data.one_liner: Create Flutter animations with chainable widgets inspired by Animate.css
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of pre-built animation widgets that wrap child widgets and handle animation controllers automatically. Animations can be chained, controlled via keys, and customized with preferences.
use_when: Want to avoid boilerplate animation controller code
Want to control animation magnitude or play state from code
avoid_when: Building highly custom or physics‑based animations that require fine‑grained control
Using animations that need complex state management beyond simple play/stop
strengths: Zero boilerplate: controller and tween setup handled internally
Supports hot‑reload restart and key‑based control
weaknesses: Limited to Animate.css‑style animations; no physics or custom tween support
No built‑in support for complex animation sequences or custom curves beyond predefined ones
Documentation is minimal; advanced usage may require reading source
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and run flutter pub get

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a similar declarative API with more built‑in animation types and easier custom tween composition

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: For vector animations from Lottie files rather than CSS‑style animations
